name: Grenadine
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix the juice and sugar in a pot or saucepan.
Boil the juice and sugar, stirring constantly, until it becomes a thick and viscous syrup resembling dark honey.
Remove from the heat, and let it cool.

culture.text: Grenadine is a nonalcoholic bar syrup commonly used as a cocktail ingredient, distinguished by its sweetness, mild flavor, and red color. Popular in mixed drinks, grenadine syrup was traditionally made from pomegranate, but today is most prevalently made from commercially produced natural or artificial flavors, as well as substitute fruits.
